(defn ns-interns
  "Returns a map of the intern mappings for the namespace."
  {:added "1.0"
   :static true}
  [ns]
  (let [ns (the-ns ns)]
    (filter-key val (fn [^clojure.lang.Var v] (and (instance? clojure.lang.Var v)
                                 (= ns (.ns v))))
                (ns-map ns))))
